boundary: Clean, known-forward, phase-zero detection only. There is no orientation, phase, window, or key-offset search. Analytic thresholds do not use prompt scores; empirical fit checks may therefore use ordinary corresponding-key scores from all prompts. Detection and null-family rates use the disjoint evaluation prompts only.

prompt_split.rule: SHA-256 rank of frozen split label and case_id

question: held-out clean watermark detection
threshold_source: analytic standard-normal quantile of the Binomial mean-g null
